extracted.name: Chocolate Protein Shake
extracted.description: The best Chocolate Protein Shake recipe is decadent, creamy, and filled with wholesome ingredients. It only takes 5 minutes and is the perfect breakfast, post-workout snack, or dessert!
ingredient_lines: 1 scoop chocolate protein powder (, (30-35 grams) good quality*)
1 Tablespoons dark unsweetened cocoa powder (, or more, to taste)
8-15 Ice cubes (, (depending how thick you’d like it))
1 Tablespoons peanut butter powder (, (PB Fit) stirred in at the end)
instruction_lines: Add protein powder, cocoa powder, almond milk, banana, and ice, to blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into cup and use a spoon to stir in peanut butter powder.
Add Optional Toppings: My favorites are Rice Krispies cereal, cacao nibs and a sprinkle of flake salt.
categories: Chocolate protein shake with peanut butter
